title: Post prices
description: Write your prices as plain text. You'll see where you stand in the market and get buyer requests. You can also send them to the bot.

sellersOnly.title: Posting prices is for entrepreneurs
sellersOnly.description: A market administration account watches prices and gets reports but doesn't sell. Reports are in your cabinet.

notRecognised: No product recognised in the message. Write the product name and price, for example: kartoshka 4500.

result.title: {count, plural, one {# price saved} other {# prices saved}}
result.review: This price is very different from usual, so it will appear after a review.
result.rejected: An admin rejected your listing for this product earlier, so buyers won't see this price. Delete it in My listings and post it again.
result.fewPrices: There are few prices for this product in your province yet: your rank will show later.

problems.unknown_unit: {product}: we don't know how many {baseUnit} are in one «{unit}». Write the price per 1 {baseUnit}.
problems.no_product: Product not recognised. For example: «kartoshka 200 kg».

channelTip: Have a Telegram channel or group? Add the bot as an admin and the prices in your posts arrive here on their own.

voice.empty: No speech was recognised. Try again or type it.
voice.denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the browser settings or type it.
voice.unsupported: This browser can't record audio. Please type it.

guide.title: How to write it
guide.text: Write the product name and the price. Quantity, unit and trade type are optional.

examples.tonnes: Potatoes, 4,500 sum per kg, 2 tonnes in stock
examples.wholesale: Apples, wholesale: the crate price is converted to a kilo

guide.lines: For several products, put each on its own line. You check everything before it is saved.
guide.voice: By voice: speak for up to {seconds} seconds and the text lands in the box.
guide.photo: From a photo: snap the board or paper with the prices on it.
